en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

...Now that just makes no sense whatsoever.
No thanks, Shuichi, I'll pass.

Sounds like you're trying to set
me up for a trap or something...

That sounds good!
What would you like to eat with the tea?

I'm pretty good at cooking,
so I can probably make something for us.

Maybe I'm not as good as Kirumi, but
I know what I'm doing. Trust me!

That's pretty unhealthy, refusing to eat.
It could be a lot of trouble for you.

In any case, I don't want to participate in
your hunger strike. Ask someone else.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
